suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to ANTI-PATTERNS or knowledge section: TipTap's StarterKit includes OrderedList by default. If workers add ordered list toolbar buttons, they must also update ALLOWED_ATTRS in html-utils.ts and add <ol> handling in convertTipTapToInlineHTML() in promotion-email-html.ts. Currently <ol> tags are allowed but stripped of all styling in email output.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature newsletter-email-integration review: <ol> in ALLOWED_TAGS but not in ALLOWED_ATTRS, and no <ol> handler in convertTipTapToInlineHTML(). TipTap StarterKit includes OrderedList extension.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document in architecture.md: sanitizeRichHTML() in html-utils.ts strips CSS expression() but not url() in style attributes, despite a comment claiming both are handled. escapeAttr() was updated to also escape ampersands (& → &) for proper attribute value escaping. isSafeURL() has a catch-all that returns true for unparseable URLs — intentional for relative URLs but worth noting for security reviews.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature newsletter-email-integration review: src/lib/html-utils.ts:170-172 comment/code mismatch, :185-188 escapeAttr update, :127 isSafeURL catch-all.

rejectedObservations.observation: Redundant javascript: regex in convertTipTapToInlineHTML only handles double-quoted attributes
rejectedObservations.reason: Not a real vulnerability — sanitizeRichHTML already handles this correctly and produces double-quoted attributes via escapeAttr. Defense-in-depth is intentional.
